Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore
(Amendment) Act 2025
Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore
(Amendment) Act 2025 (Commencement)
Notification 2026
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 1 of the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Amendment) Act 2025, the Minister for Transport makes the following Notification:
